note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list as published on Exophase and cross-checked with PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements. Hidden flags follow the visible/hidden split published by PlanetGTA6. Every guide below is written in our own words; a source is cited beside each fact it supports, never copied.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the receipt for everything else: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, with no extra task of its own. Follow the roadmap in order — story first, strangers second, collectibles and activities third — and treat this as the finish line, not a trophy to chase directly.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
The platinum unlocks automatically once the last one lands.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening mission. Play through Gone Fishing to the end and the trophy lands with the mission-complete screen — there is nothing to find or collect first. Like every story trophy, it stays hidden on PSN until you earn it, so the spoiler setting masks it here until then.
steps: Start the story and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
Finish the mission; the trophy unlocks on completion.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and this unlocks with the chapter's end. Before you leave Chapter 1, read the warning on Positive Mental Attitude: one meditation spot, on Lucia's balcony, is only reachable in this chapter, and there is no mission replay and no New Game+ to go back for it.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 1's missions.
Before the chapter ends, meditate at the balcony spot for Positive Mental Attitude.

sources.name: KeenGamer
sources.what: Chapter 1 balcony spot is the one potentially missable moment

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: A chapter-completion trophy: play Chapter 2 through to its final mission and it unlocks on the chapter's close. No collectible or side task feeds into it — the story is the requirement, and the name is printed with asterisks exactly as PlayStation publishes it.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 2's missions.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 and this pops with the chapter-complete screen. By this point the stranger strands are opening across Leonida; you can dip into them between missions, but nothing in this chapter depends on them — come back to strangers as a block in roadmap stage 4.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 3's missions.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: The last chapter trophy before the finale: complete Chapter 4 and it unlocks. If you have been keeping manual saves at chapter boundaries, this is a good moment to make another one — the final mission follows, and a save here is cheap insurance for any cleanup you still owe the story.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 4's missions.
Finish the chapter's final mission.
Make a manual save before the finale.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: One of only two gold trophies: finish the final mission and the story is done. It is the natural end of roadmap stage 3 — after it, the game opens up for the long cleanup of strangers, collectibles, activities and robberies, and the 100% chase behind A Long Road.
steps: Complete Chapters 1 to 4.
Finish the final mission; the gold unlocks on completion.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: A mission trophy: complete the mission Breakfast Run and it unlocks. Mission trophies need no preparation — play the mission, finish it, and the trophy follows. If a mission ever feels hard, it is worth remembering there is no mission replay, so a manual save before a tough mission is the only way back.
steps: Reach the mission Breakfast Run in the story.
Complete it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are the big set-pieces of the story, and this trophy is simply their receipt — no side objective, no timer, no optional condition is attached to it in the official description.
steps: Reach the mission The Cartel Heist in the story.
Complete it.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. The mission's name is the only hint the official description gives, and that is enough: mission trophies unlock on completion, with no extra condition to meet.
steps: Reach the mission Child's Play in the story.
Complete it.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. As with every mission trophy, the unlock is the mission-complete screen itself — play it through, and the trophy is yours whether you rush it or take your time.
steps: Reach the mission Headliners in the story.
Complete it.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set at the Vice City airport. The airport returns later for Catch Me If You Can, so while you are here, note the layout — but this trophy itself only asks that the mission be finished.
steps: Reach the mission VCIA Takedown in the story.
Complete it.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is the last of the named mission trophies before the finale, and like the others it unlocks on completion alone — the official description attaches no optional objective to it.
steps: Reach the mission Operation Savage Glory in the story.
Complete it.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The second gold trophy, and the long one: reach 100% completion. Rockstar has not published what the 100% checklist contains, so no guide can honestly list its tasks yet — the visible trophies give the shape of it (story, strangers, collectibles, activities, robberies, money, exploration), and the in-game stats page is the authority once you are playing. Treat any claimed 35-task checklist as unverified: it circulates without a source.
steps: Finish the story and the stranger strands.
Clear the collectibles, activities, robberies and money trophies.
Check the in-game 100% stats page for what is left; that page, not any website, is the checklist.

sources.name: PlanetGTA6
sources.what: 100% contents not published by Rockstar; story takes about 60 hours per reviews

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near misses, drifts and air time all count toward the total, and the counter runs through the whole game, so normal driving already banks progress. The efficient way is to grind it late, in free roam after the story, at a spot with a good ramp and a fast car, rather than forcing it mission by mission.
steps: Drive fast and stunt through normal play; the counter tracks 250 stunts.
After the story, grind the remainder in free roam with jumps and near misses.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type once — nine types in all, from races and fishing to the shooting range, the arcade and drone races. This is the sampler trophy: it rewards breadth, not mastery, so one quick try at each is enough, and it pairs naturally with the first visit to each activity while you are exploring.
steps: Visit each activity type and try it once.
Nine types in total; one attempt each is enough.

sources.name: PSNProfiles
sources.what: PSN target: every activity type, nine in all

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal all 42 Shooting Range challenges. The range is a pure skill check: learn each challenge's target pattern, then run it until the gold time or score lands. Do it in one focused block after the story, when you can retry instantly without mission pressure, and save the hardest challenges for last, once the range's rhythm is familiar.
steps: Find a Shooting Range and learn its challenges.
Gold-medal each of the 42 challenges; retry instantly on a miss.

sources.name: PSNProfiles
sources.what: PSN target: gold in all 42 challenges

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Drone racing is about the racing line, not speed alone: learn each course's gates on a practice run, then race it for the win. The locations unlock as you explore, so this is a cleanup trophy best finished in free roam with the map open.
steps: Unlock Top Fun drone races by exploring.
Win a race at each of the 14 locations.

sources.name: PSNProfiles
sources.what: PSN target: a win at every location, 14 in all

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the word different is doing the work: replaying one easy race twenty times does not count. Race across Leonida's circuits, street races and off-road events, and keep a mental note of which you have won; the counter is per race, not per win.
steps: Race across Leonida's circuits, street and off-road events.
Win 20 different races, one win each.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the early activities, and Cal is the rival the challenge names — take the challenge when it appears, watch the line tension, and reel steady rather than fast. It is a single win, not a series, so one good catch settles it.
steps: Find a fishing spot and take Cal's challenge.
Beat Cal in the challenge.

sources.name: PlanetGTA6
sources.what: Visible trophy; fishing challenge against Cal

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game, start to end. Arcades are scattered around Leonida and the games are short, so this is one of the quickest trophies in the set — pick any machine, learn its one rule, and play it through to the end screen.
steps: Find an arcade machine anywhere in Leonida.
Complete one arcade game.

sources.name: PlanetGTA6
sources.what: Visible trophy; one arcade game completed

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last mission. Stranger strands are the game's side stories: each stranger has a chain of missions, and this trophy is the end of Andy's chain. Meet Andy where his strand opens, work through his missions in order, and the trophy lands on the final one. Stranger missions are all available after the story, so there is no rush.
steps: Find Andy and start his stranger strand.
Play his missions through to the final one.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last mission. Kenton's strand is one of the five named stranger chains, and its finale is the trophy — the title hints at a boat, but the requirement is only the mission itself. Work his strand in order; the missions unlock one after another, so there is no way to skip to the end.
steps: Find Kenton and start his stranger strand.
Play his missions through to the final one.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission. Billy's strand is the biker-flavoured one of the five named chains — the title says lone rider, and the missions follow that shape. As with the other strangers, the chain plays in order and the trophy is the finale, available any time after the strand opens.
steps: Find Billy and start his stranger strand.
Play his missions through to the final one.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Five of the strands have named finales — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — so three more unnamed strands are needed to reach eight. Explore the map, answer every stranger marker, and finish each chain you start; the silver lands on the eighth completed strand.
steps: Play the five named stranger strands to their finales.
Find and complete three more stranger strands across Leonida.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's last mission. Randy's strand is one of the five named stranger chains, and its finale is the trophy. Stranger strands are designed as a block of side content — do them together in roadmap stage 4, after the story, when the whole map is open and nothing interrupts the chains.
steps: Find Randy and start his stranger strand.
Play his missions through to the final one.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last mission — the fifth and final named stranger finale. Once all five named finales are done, only three unnamed strands stand between you and the Strangers & Freaks silver, so this is a good moment to sweep the map for any stranger marker you have not answered yet.
steps: Find Tyrone and start his stranger strand.
Play his missions through to the final one.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — and mind the one that can be missed. Multiple guides agree that Lucia's balcony spot is only reachable in Chapter 1, and with no mission replay and no New Game+, missing it strands the trophy: meditate there before Chapter 1 ends, and keep a manual save from Chapter 1 until the trophy pops. Beyond that one spot, no other missable has been confirmed anywhere — PlanetGTA6 is explicit that there is no reliable missable list yet — so treat this as the single trophy that needs a save, and the rest of the spots as ordinary cleanup.
steps: In Chapter 1, meditate at the balcony spot before the chapter ends.
Keep a Chapter 1 manual save until the trophy unlocks.
Meditate at the other 17 spots across Leonida as you explore.

sources.name: KeenGamer
sources.what: Chapter 1 balcony spot disappears after Chapter 1; no mission replay, no New Game+

sources.name: PlanetGTA6
sources.what: No reliable list of missable trophies beyond this one; 18 spots in all

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. This is a stranger strand with a hunting twist: Bret's chain leads to one particular animal, and the trophy is the successful hunt. Track it, take the shot cleanly, and bring the hunt home — the trophy is the hunt itself, not a count of animals.
steps: Find Bret and start his strand.
Follow the strand to the unique animal and hunt it.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida, and a set is only done when every card in it is found — so this is a sweep trophy, not a shopping trip. Work one set at a time with a checklist, mark each card as you find it, and expect the last few cards of each set to be the ones tucked into corners you have already walked past.
steps: Find cards across Leonida; each belongs to a set.
Complete any 3 full sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the game's photo-sharing hook — open it at a spot, take the shot, and the location ticks off. One hundred sounds like a lot until you realise every viewpoint, landmark and odd corner counts, so fold it into exploring: WAiNK at each new place as you arrive, and the counter climbs without a dedicated grind.
steps: Open WAiNK It at a location and take the shot.
Repeat at 100 different locations, folding it into exploring.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's small goals — one-off tasks scattered through activities and the open world — and they stack up through ordinary play. If you reach the endgame short of fifty, the in-game challenge list is the map: work it top to bottom, easiest first, and the last few will be the ones that need a specific activity.
steps: Complete challenges as they come up in play.
Use the in-game challenge list to mop up the remainder to 50.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. The partner is the condition that makes this different from an ordinary escape: do it as a pair, break line of sight, and keep moving until the stars clear. A fast car and open road help; a dead end does not.
steps: Raise a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you.
Break line of sight and escape until the wanted level clears.

sources.name: PlanetGTA6
sources.what: Visible trophy; 4-star wanted level with partner

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level alive the whole time. The trick is the opposite of a normal escape: you want the heat to stay, not clear. Pick three shops close together, move fast between them, and do not lose the cops before the third till is empty.
steps: Start a robbery with your partner and gain a wanted level.
Rob two more shops back-to-back without losing the wanted level.

sources.name: PlanetGTA6
sources.what: Visible trophy; 3 shops back-to-back, wanted level kept

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Discovery is about variety: each new model you get into counts once, so the counter rewards a magpie habit — hop into anything you have not driven, from work trucks to sports cars. It pairs with exploring and with On the Spot, which wants ten of those vehicles registered to the Scooter Bros app.
steps: Get into any vehicle you have not driven before; each new model counts.
Work through 100 different vehicles as you explore.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-down aiming mode, and the window is short — so set it up: find a spot with five enemies grouped, trigger Focus, and work through them before it ends. A mission with a crowded firefight is the easiest stage; free-roam ambushes work too if you pick the ground first.
steps: Find five enemies grouped together.
Trigger Combat Focus and down all five before it ends.

sources.name: PlanetGTA6
sources.what: Visible trophy; 5 enemies in one Combat Focus

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport. The official description leaves the method open — the plain reading is to take a plane out without a flight plan, on your own terms. Head to VCIA in free roam, get to an aircraft, and leave by air; no checked guide has yet pinned down a single required method, so treat any specific route as unconfirmed until the community settles it.
steps: Go to VCIA in free roam.
Depart by aircraft without a scheduled flight.

sources.name: PlanetGTA6
sources.what: Hidden on PSN until earned; no checked method published yet

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Face the Rhinos — the tanks. The official description is a joke, not an instruction, and no checked guide has yet pinned down the exact trigger, so the honest read is this: engage a Rhino tank and survive the encounter on your terms, whether that means taking one on in combat or making it through a tank-led chase. Check the community threads for the settled method before grinding it; do not take any single video's claim as fact.
steps: Find a Rhino tank encounter in free roam or a mission.
Survive the encounter with the tank.

sources.name: PlanetGTA6
sources.what: Hidden on PSN until earned; exact trigger not yet confirmed

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being seen. Stealth is the whole trophy: case the store, move when the staff are not looking, and be out before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — leave, let the heat die, and try again rather than fighting through it.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and watch its staff.
Take the goods without being detected; if spotted, leave and retry.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Vaults are the heavyweight robberies: plan the approach, hit the vault, and — the part the trophy actually checks — get away clean afterwards. Five successful escapes, not five attempts, so a clean getaway matters as much as the break-in; bring a fast car and a route out before you go in.
steps: Find a bank vault and rob it.
Escape clean after each robbery; repeat for 5 vaults.

sources.name: PSNProfiles
sources.what: PSN target: 5 bank vaults robbed and escaped

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run routes around Leonida — find one, stop it, take the cash, and then do the part that counts: escape. The robbery is the easy half; the getaway is the trophy, so have your escape car ready before you make the hit.
steps: Find an armored truck on its route.
Rob it, then escape clean.

sources.name: PlanetGTA6
sources.what: Visible trophy; armored truck robbery and escape

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. This is the map-completion trophy: every named area visited, from Vice City's streets to the swamps and the keys. It finishes itself if you explore properly — the trick is the in-game map, which shows what is left. Do it last, in free roam, and mop up the areas the story never took you to.
steps: Explore Leonida through the story and side content.
Use the in-game map to find unvisited areas; visit all 52.

sources.name: PSNProfiles
sources.what: PSN target: all 52 areas of Leonida

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Gangs run their own operations around Leonida, and the trophy wants one hit on each gang's turf — nine gangs, nine robberies. Learn which gang holds which area, hit one operation per gang, and keep count; the last gang is usually the one whose territory you have visited least.
steps: Learn which gang holds which area of Leonida.
Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs.

sources.name: PSNProfiles
sources.what: PSN target: one operation from each of the 9 gangs

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This one is a breather, not a challenge: go to Ocean Beach, find a spot serving drinks with the ocean in front of you, and order one. The ellipsis in the title is the joke — the beginning, a drink, a view — and the trophy is simply the moment.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Order a cocktail with the view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom, in classic style. The description is a nod to the series' oldest joke — driving through a showroom window — and the trophy is exactly that moment: get a car inside a showroom, then leave through the glass. Free roam is the place for it; no mission is required.
steps: Take a car into a vehicle showroom.
Smash out through the showroom glass.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. The name is a series in-joke — an old line from an old game — but the ask is simple: go to the alley and follow through on a game. It is a one-visit trophy, and a good palate cleanser between the long grinds.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a game through.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — the official description is deliberately vague, and no checked guide has yet pinned down the trigger. The plain reading is a moment with your partner that the public notices: a shared feat that gets attention. Until the community settles the exact condition, treat this as one to watch rather than one to grind: play the story and the partner content, and check the community threads for the confirmed trigger before chasing it.
steps: Play the story and partner content through.
Check the community threads for the confirmed trigger, then do it.

sources.name: PlanetGTA6
sources.what: Hidden on PSN until earned; no checked trigger published yet

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. The description reads like a running count of decisions, and no checked guide has yet published what the count is or what it totals — so do not chase a number nobody has confirmed. Play the story making real choices, take the stranger strands, and let the counter fill; the community threads are where a confirmed total will appear first.
steps: Play the story and stranger strands, making choices as they come.
Watch for a confirmed total in the community threads before grinding.

sources.name: PlanetGTA6
sources.what: Hidden on PSN until earned; trigger not yet confirmed

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description points at a retry: something failed once, then worked on the second try. No checked guide has yet named which attempt counts, so the honest advice is to play normally and let it come — a failed attempt followed by a success is something every player does by accident. If it has not popped by the endgame, the community threads will have settled which retry it is.
steps: Play through the game; a failed attempt followed by a success is normal play.
If it has not popped by the endgame, check the community threads for the settled retry.

sources.name: PlanetGTA6
sources.what: Hidden on PSN until earned; trigger not yet confirmed

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The title is the giveaway: this is the game's strange-encounter trophy, the kind that pops when you witness something that does not belong. No checked guide has yet named the event, so do not go hunting a specific spot on a rumour — explore, keep an eye out for the odd and the unexplained, and let the community threads settle the location first.
steps: Explore Leonida and watch for something strange.
Check the community threads for the confirmed event before hunting a spot.

sources.name: PlanetGTA6
sources.what: Hidden on PSN until earned; event not yet confirmed

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — a drive-by with a melee weapon, from a moving vehicle. The bowling pun is the aim: line up a target, swing from the car as you pass, and the trophy is the hit. It is easier at low speed on a straight road than at full throttle; one clean connection is all it takes.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle.
Drive past a target and land a melee hit from the car.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies, and laundering is how they become clean spendable cash — find your contacts, move the bills through them, and the total climbs with every job. It pairs with the robbery trophies: rob, launder, repeat, and a quarter of a million arrives as a side effect of the vaults and trucks.
steps: Rob banks, trucks and stores to earn Marked Bills.
Launder the bills through your contacts until $250,000 is clean.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every shop counts — clothes, weapons, food, car mods — so this is a spending total, not a single purchase. It finishes itself if you buy gear as you go; if you reach the endgame short, a big purchase at a car mod shop or a weapons stock-up closes the gap in one visit.
steps: Buy gear, clothes, weapons and car mods as you play.
Spend $100,000 in total across all shops.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages are the safehouses for your vehicle collection — each one you buy is a permanent base and a step toward this trophy. They cost money, so this is a late-game purchase: earn through robberies and laundering first, then buy the garages in a row and the trophy lands on the eighth.
steps: Earn money through robberies and laundering.
Buy all 8 garage properties.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. As you discover new vehicles for Whip It Good, register the best ten through the app — it is the same habit, one extra step. Ten registrations, not ten purchases, so any vehicle you find and register counts.
steps: Discover vehicles as you explore Leonida.
Register 10 of them to the Scooter Bros app.
